headline: Trump Weighs Limited Attacks in Strait of Hormuz
summary: US President Donald Trump is weighing limited attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, according to reports. Iranian missiles have reportedly targeted bases in Jordan and the Emirates.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so military activity there directly affects energy supply and prices.
why_moved: Reports of possible US strikes and Iranian missile attacks on regional bases raise supply-disruption risk in the Gulf.
